First, note that $(\genfrac{}{}{0pt}{}{20}{16})$ means the same thing as ${}_{20}{C}_{16}.$

 In general, the number of combinations of $n$ objects taken $r$ at a time is given by the formula

$$
{}_{n}{C}_{r}=\frac{n!}{(n-r)!\,r!}.
$$

Substituting $n=20$ and $r=16,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{}_{20}{C}_{16} & =\frac{20!}{(20-16)!16!} \\  & =\frac{20!}{4!16!} \\  & =\frac{20\cdot 19\cdot 18\cdot 17\cdot \cancel{16!}}{4!\cancel{16!}} \\  & =\frac{20\cdot 19\cdot 18\cdot 17}{4\cdot 3\cdot 2\cdot 1} \\  & =\frac{116\,280}{24} \\  & =4\,845.\end{aligned}
$$
